orientationReview.method: Individually measured and visually reviewed exported pixels. Rotation baked into full-resolution files; runtime rotation is zero. Original files preserved in private audit backup. Perspective and wear unchanged.

photoLibrary.method: Native Photoshop, non-generative tone/crop/background isolation and individually reviewed pixel leveling. Full-resolution masters retained. Quality-96 WebP, exact alpha and lossless front thumbnails. Validated artifact database controls associations.
